validity.recommendation: Check capacity: sheet 2.00 bcm/y has no source; 1999 sources say up to 4 bcm/y, Romanian operator lists 2.71 bcm/y at the border point. Length 20.6 km is the Ukrainian section only; the drawn route is the whole 53 km corridor.
validity.researcher_notes: The pipeline is real. A December 1999 Interfax-Ukraine wire story and the Naftogaz history page both name the Khust-Satu Mare line, and the Romanian grid operator lists the matching Tekovo to Medies Aurit border point today. Length (20.6 km), diameter (720 mm) and start year (1999) match the wire story exactly. It is not a duplicate of any other row in the list: it is the only Ukraine to Romania line at Khust. It is correctly a gas transmission export line. The one disagreement is capacity: the sheet has 2 bcm/y, the two 1999 sources say up to 4 bcm/y, and the Romanian operator gives 2.71 bcm/y for the crossing. Ownership at the border: the Ukrainian operator, with Ukrtransgaz as builder in 1999.

fills.researcher_notes: The sheet says 2.00 bcm/y and cites nothing. Two 1999 sources say the line was built to carry up to 4 bcm a year. The Romanian grid operator lists the Tekovo to Medies Aurit border point at 2.71 bcm/y technical capacity, which is a third figure for the crossing. An earlier pass cited an EEGA page for 2 bcm/y, but that page now returns 404 and its archived copy does not mention the crossing, so I did not use it. Staged the sources' 4 bcm/y with low confidence. The sheet value needs a person to decide.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Newest dated evidence is the English Wikipedia article on the Ukrainian grid, which covers 2023 and lists the line as a working export line. The Romanian grid operator page lists the Tekovo to Medies Aurit border point as live but is undated. I found no source from 2024 or later that says gas flowed through this line, and no source saying it is idle. No change is proposed and the sheet status is left as operating. Searched in Ukrainian, Russian and English.

summary: Real, not a duplicate. Length, diameter, start match 1999 wire story. Capacity 2 bcm/y disagrees with sources (4 bcm/y; 2.71 at border). Status unclear after 2023.
